mechanisms.decisive_claim: In every hard maximum-witness configuration, the canonically defined fixed-endpoint legal-token sets Q_gamma satisfy |union_{gamma in S} Q_gamma| >= |S| for every repeated-colour set S.
mechanisms.kill_test: Verify every subset on the sharp parity recolourings, then seek a two-star graph-realizable deficient set rather than choosing orientations after the set is known.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: The inequalities |Q| >= D_B and E_0 <= 4f(D_B-1) alone imply the full label--reserve Hall inequalities for all repeated-colour subfamilies.
would_close: Branch A/B reserve payment from inherited scalars
mechanisms.kill_test: Give two colours the same singleton legal set while adding unused tokens to the global union so all total-cardinality inequalities still hold.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: Existential proper two-label words of the induced-matching colour graphs force a common endpoint agreement that bounds repeated-colour defect.
mechanisms.kill_test: Use the full 2^t independent edge-flip gauge and the sharp 2K2 recolouring to realize every outer-endpoint word at fixed defect.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: An unrooted matching colour graph admits an automorphism-equivariant canonical orientation, yielding precommitted endpoint labels with no extra geometric input.
mechanisms.kill_test: Apply the endpoint-swap automorphism of a single K2: equivariance would have to preserve and reverse the chosen orientation simultaneously.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: If every selected coherent star has at least as many incident legal reserve tokens as repeated colours on that star, then the union over all selected stars has a simultaneous system of distinct representatives.
mechanisms.kill_test: Use two one-colour stars sharing their sole legal token; each star passes locally but their union has matching number one.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: For the exact typed three-budget network, every minimum cut of capacity below the repeated-colour demand induces one of the already isolated A, B-same, or B-opposite scalar obstruction inequalities.
would_close: one interface joining A, B-same, and B-opposite
mechanisms.kill_test: Encode the sharp reserve-paid family and all minimal two-colour overlapping-token cuts; reject the claim if a new cut type is not represented by the canonical branches.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: The parity stability energy E(a,h,u,T) by itself forces label--reserve Hall expansion whenever the scalar B-opposite constraints are feasible.
mechanisms.kill_test: Keep (a,h,u,T,D_B,|Q|) fixed but replace the colour-token incidence by two identical singleton neighbourhoods; scalar energy is unchanged while Hall fails.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: Every alternation from a deficient colour family to a coherent star and then to a new deficient family strictly increases the scalar pair (number of exposed reserve tokens, degree-spread energy).
mechanisms.kill_test: Run the abstract four-cycle c1--q1--c2--q2 with alternating witness choices and test whether the claimed scalar state returns unchanged.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: A fixed finite list of bounded-radius rooted coloured densities determines whether the global colour--token incidence system satisfies Hall.
would_close: finite local certificate for all hard branches
mechanisms.kill_test: Compare long even incidence cycles with a disjoint union containing one over-demanded component; match all fixed-radius neighbourhood frequencies while changing global Hall deficit.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: Positive marginal token entropy for every repeated colour, together with total reserve size at least D_B, implies a collision-free reserve assignment.
mechanisms.kill_test: Take two colours both uniformly supported on the same singleton token and add unused reserve tokens outside their supports.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: Any minimum-rank deficient repeated-colour set can be uncrossed to a geometrically coherent zero-shore family whose deficit is charged injectively to the audited A/B/residual budgets.
would_close: reduction to one auditable coherent obstruction
mechanisms.kill_test: Enumerate minimal abstract deficient families of size at most four and test whether uncrossing preserves fixed endpoints and typed token provenance; then require graph realizability for survivors.
mechanisms.second_wave_result: The current ownership-blind ledger is insufficient. A three-colour tight circuit has two realizations with identical mu, E_A, rectangle-product, S_m, degree, and branch scalars: one is completed by an A atom owned by a circuit colour and one is not. This is a sharp abstract indistinguishability result, not a graph-realizable counterexample.
mechanisms.survives_only_as: a graph-specific ownership or C7-exit theorem showing that every hard tight circuit receives one genuinely new actual resource atom with owner neighbourhood meeting the circuit, plus a distinctness theorem across simultaneous circuits
mechanisms.minimal_sound_capacity: rho(T)=number of actual A/B/slack atoms whose precommitted owner neighbourhood intersects T; this coverage rank is submodular and prevents double spending of mu
mechanisms.graph_realizability_result: Empty A ownership is impossible: every repeated colour bx_gamma,cy_gamma owns the missing A edge x_gamma y_gamma, and these diagonal atoms are distinct within one coherent opposite star. The earlier path-shaped B incidence also cannot be a canonical full-reserve system because base pairs belong to their own reserves and equal bases have equal reserves.
mechanisms.exact_surviving_obstruction: A 14-vertex graph with 50 edges, minimum degree 4, L4(2), rainbow C7, and a maximum-witness B-opposite pair realizes three repeated colours sharing the two-token full reserve {bc,cz}; its three owned A diagonal atoms are distinct. Hence tight circuits do not themselves force a C7.
mechanisms.survives_only_as_after_graph_probe: a typed nonlinear conversion from the injective A diagonal ownership/whole anticomplete rectangle to S_m or additional B reserve, together with cross-star overlap control; not an ownership-existence conjecture

mechanisms.decisive_claim: A large matching or chromatic lower bound in the colour-conflict auxiliary graph forces the required number of distinct reserve tokens.
would_close: repeated-colour defect payment from conflict structure
mechanisms.kill_test: Use the sharp 2K2 recolouring, where repeated colours may share a common reserve neighbourhood while the actual token injection depends on capacity not conflict adjacency.
